title: Program review PRG-X
utterances: Alluminio Bormida is two weeks late on BR-220 blanks, their saw line is down.
We can run eight days on stock.
Escalate to Bormida management today, and bring options to the change board.

decisions.text: Escalate SUP-B delay; options to change board.
decisions.reason: Two-week delay against eight days of stock.
